lupo.tuo: At night you choose, with the other werewolves, who to devour. By day you pretend to be innocent.
lupo.regolamento: At night, chooses with the other werewolves who to devour. By day, pretends to be innocent.

contadino.tuo: You have no powers: help find the werewolves by talking and voting.
contadino.regolamento: Has no powers: helps find the werewolves by talking and voting.

veggente.tuo: Every night you find out whether a player is a werewolf.
veggente.regolamento: Every night, finds out whether a player is a werewolf.

medico.tuo: Every night you protect one player from the werewolves (never the same one two nights in a row).
medico.regolamento: Every night, protects one player from the werewolves (never the same one two nights in a row).
